notes: Hero consular beat: a synthetic passport renewal for a Nigerian student in Australia. inputs_used names exactly the four metadata fields the brief permits, which is what makes 'metadata only' checkable on screen rather than merely asserted.

result.rationale: Proposed from metadata only: case type PASSPORT_RENEWAL, case age 16 days against a 21-day budget, SLA clock running, status ASSIGNED. The published renewal process requires an online Nigeria Immigration Service application followed by an in-person appointment in Canberra, with appointment slots limited to Tuesday to Thursday mornings, so the remaining budget is appointment-constrained rather than processing-constrained. NO CASE NARRATIVE WAS READ: nothing about the applicant, their circumstances or their correspondence entered this proposal.

Check the next available Tuesday to Thursday appointment against the SLA budget
